ayahs.1: (Saari cheezen) jo aasmanon aur zameen mein hain Allah Taala ki paaki bayan karti hain (jo) Badshah, Nihayat Paak (hai), Ghaalib-o-Ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.2: Wohi hai jis ne naa-khwaanda logon mein un hi mein se ek Rasool bheja jo unhein us ki aayatein padh kar sunaata hai aur un ko paak karta hai aur unhein Kitaab-o-Hikmat sikhaata hai. Yaqeenan yeh is se pehle khuli gumraahi mein the.
ayahs.3: Aur doosron ke liye bhi unhi mein se jo ab tak un se nahin mile. Aur wohi Ghaalib-o-Ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.4: Yeh Allah ka fazl hai jise chaahe apna fazl de aur Allah Taala bahut bade fazl ka Maalik hai.
ayahs.5: Jin logon ko Taurat par amal karne ka hukm diya gaya phir unhon ne is par amal nahin kiya un ki misaal is gadhe ki si hai jo bahut si kitaaben laade hue ho. Allah ki baaton ko jhutlaane walon ki badi buri misaal hai aur Allah (aisi) zaalim qaum ko hidayat nahin deta.
ayahs.6: Keh dijiye ke ae Yahoodiyo! Agar tumhara daawa hai ke tum Allah ke dost ho doosre logon ke siwa to tum maut ki tamanna karo agar tum sachche ho.
ayahs.7: Yeh kabhi bhi maut ki tamanna na karenge ba-wajah un aamaal ke jo apne aage apne haathon bhej rakhe hain aur Allah zaalimon ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.8: Keh dijiye! Ke jis maut se tum bhaagte phirte ho woh to tumhein pahunch kar rahegi phir tum sab chhupe khule ke jaanne wale (Allah) ki taraf lautaaye jaaoge aur woh tumhein tumhare kiye hue tamaam kaam batla dega.
ayahs.9: Ae woh logo jo imaan laaye ho! Jumaa ke din namaz ki azaan di jaaye to tum Allah ke zikr ki taraf daud pado aur khareed-o-farokht chhod do. Yeh tumhare haq mein bahut hi behtar hai agar tum jaante ho.
ayahs.10: Phir jab namaz ho chuke to zameen mein phail jaao aur Allah ka fazl talaash karo aur ba-kasrat Allah ka zikr kiya karo taake tum falah paao.
ayahs.11: Aur jab koi sauda bikta dekhen ya koi tamaasha nazar aa jaaye to us ki taraf daud jaate hain aur Aap ko khada hi chhod dete hain. Aap keh dijiye ke Allah ke paas jo hai woh khel aur tijaarat se behtar hai. Aur Allah Taala behtareen rozi-rasaan hai.
